title: [SDK 50] Pod install error: The Swift pod `ExpoModulesCore` depends upon `glog`, which does not define modules.
body:
### Minimal reproducible example

https://github.com/NervJS/taro-native-shell/tree/0.73.0

### Summary

### error info
```log
[!] The following Swift pods cannot yet be integrated as static libraries:

The Swift pod `ExpoModulesCore` depends upon `glog`, which does not define modules. To opt into those targets generating module maps (which is necessary to import them from Swift when building as static libraries), you may set `use_modular_headers!` globally in your Podfile, or specify `:modular_headers => true` for particular dependencies.
Error: Process completed with exit code 1.
```
### build action
https://github.com/NervJS/taro-native-shell/actions/runs/7194009870/job/19593603408

### Environment

see actionlog

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Hey @reporter, looks like you have the `expo-modules-core` package in the dependencies, which is not recommended. That package should only be a transitive dependency of the `expo` package. By specifying it as your direct dependency, you're using a different version that is intended to be used with SDK 50. Can you try removing it from your package.json, run yarn again and reinstall pods?

As I'm almost sure it's the cause of the issue, I'm going to close it beforehand. Let me know if you're still experiencing it even after going through my instructions.

comments.body:
This issue started occurring after upgrading to React Native 0.74 and expo 51 (a bare RN project with expo added).

In my case, the error read:

> The following Swift pods cannot yet be integrated as static libraries:
> The Swift pod `ExpoModulesCore` depends upon `DoubleConversion`, which does not define modules. 

The error occurs **only on the build server**. On my local machine (Mac OS 14.5 with M1 Pro chip and XCode 15.4), everything works fine.

I started digging into the differences between my local machine and the build agent. We use Azure pipelines and the error occurs when using either [macOS-13](https://github.com/actions/runner-images/blob/main/images/macos/macos-13-Readme.md) or [macOS-14](https://github.com/actions/runner-images/blob/main/images/macos/macos-14-Readme.md) hosted build agents. Currently both agents use XCode v15.0.1 by default (although the default versions will soon change to 15.2 and 15.4 resp.).

I forced the XCode version to 15.4 on the macOS-14 build agent, to be sure the same macOS and XCode version as my local machine is used. Unfortunately, this did not resolve the issue. It **doesn't seem related to the XCode version** in my case, although it's most likely related to the machine and software specs.

Using Cocoapods v1.15.2. Podfile.lock tells me ExpoModulesCore v1.12.19 is installed.

Any other ideas would be greatly appreciated.
